blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Deo Cuajao had a golden opportunity to help Rain or Shine pull closer late in Game 2 of the PBA Governors’ Cup. Fouled while taking a 4-point shot, Cuajao could only make two of his free throws as Converge escaped with a 130-125 victory to tie the quarterfinals series. The Elasto Painters were trailing, 123-129, with 30 seconds remaining when Cuajao was fouled by Calvin Abueva. “Nakakapanghinayang. We had a chance to give our team a fight until the end but I missed the first two. Nakakapanghinayang,” he told the Inquirer at Ninoy Aquino Stadium on Friday. Fortunately for the […]...
